Could use some help please.  Local tests are passing (using recommended dev container setup). 

Assuming something weird is going on with my local setup and the github CI error is valid:  it seems to be an issue calling `self.coordinator.config_entry.async_start_reauth(self.hass)` from inside a sync function.  Is there a proper way to `await` something inside a sync function?
Use the async arm methods instead and wrap the call that needs to run in the executor in self.hass.async_add_executor_job

Wrap the executor call in a try the except block you need to raise in the event loop to the async function (and remove the except from the code that runs in the executor) 

Sent from my iPhone

> On Apr 2, 2022, at 8:54 PM, Austin Mroczek ***@***.***> wrote:
> 
> ﻿
> I'd love to do that but have a big try block catching exceptions from the line that needs the executor:
> 
>    async def async_alarm_arm_home_instant(self, code=None):
>         """Send arm home instant command."""
>         await self.hass.async_add_executor_job(self._arm_home_instant)
>         await self.coordinator.async_request_refresh()
> 
>     def _arm_home_instant(self):
>         """Arm home instant synchronous."""
>         try:
>             ArmingHelper(self._partition).arm_stay_instant()
>         except UsercodeInvalid as error:
>             self.coordinator.config_entry.async_start_reauth(self.hass)
>             raise HomeAssistantError(
>                 "TotalConnect usercode is invalid. Did not arm home instant"
>             ) from error
>         except BadResultCodeError as error:
>             raise HomeAssistantError(
>                 f"TotalConnect failed to arm home instant {self._name}."
>             ) from error
> —
> Reply to this email directly, view it on GitHub, or unsubscribe.
> You are receiving this because you commented.

`pytest tests/components/totalconnect/ --cov=homeassistant.components.totalconnect --cov-report term-missing -vv` 
results in

`codecov/patch/config-flows` test shows a bunch of un-related files pulling down the coverage numbers.

Do I just need to re-base to fix this?
